description: Implementation of the PaymentService interface handling payment processing, configuration, and validation within an e-commerce system. Includes methods for retrieving payment methods, processing payments, refunds, and validating credit cards.

classes.name: PaymentServiceImpl
classes.description: Concrete service class implementing the PaymentService interface, managing payment processing, configuration, and validation logic.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available payment integration modules for a given merchant store, filtering by region.

methods.name: getAcceptedPaymentMethods
methods.description: Returns a list of accepted and active payment methods for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByType
methods.description: Finds a payment method integration module based on its type for a specified store.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a specific payment method integration module identified by its code.

methods.name: getPaymentConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches configuration details for a specific payment module for a store.

methods.name: getPaymentModulesConfigured
methods.description: Loads all payment modules configuration for a store, decrypting stored data.

methods.name: savePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates and saves the configuration for a payment module for a store.

methods.name: removePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes configuration entries for a specified payment module from a store.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Initiates a payment transaction, handling authorization, capture, and validation.

methods.name: getPaymentModule
methods.description: Accesses a payment module implementation based on code.

methods.name: processCapturePayment
methods.description: Processes a capture (finalization) of a previously authorized transaction.

methods.name: processRefund
methods.description: Handles a refund process for an order, validating amounts and transaction states.

methods.name: validateCreditCard
methods.description: Performs validation on credit card details, including number format and date validity, using Luhn algorithm.
